scope: Nine fixed characters: additional public institutional worksheets

sources.access: Public HTTP post and normal anonymous cookie-session download; no authenticated account used. HTTPS certificate was expired; no certificate validation was disabled.

attachments.label: 3∥급 한자 [1].pdf
attachments.inspection: All page text extracted in RAM; page 1 rendered and visually read. Four columns of single glyph, Korean meaning/reading and radical. 訣 row visible on page 1. No cumulative stroke sequence on the inspected page.

attachments.label: 3Ⅱ급 한자 [2].pdf
attachments.inspection: All page text extracted in RAM. Header identifies 1,500-character allocation list. Visual page inspection not completed; text extraction has broken character maps.

sources.limitations: Allocation/reading evidence is not whole-stroke evidence. Corrupt text mapping and limited visual scope prevent a global claim that no other page could contain relevant content.

sources.title: 3 그려서 만든 한자(필순 한자 쓰기)
sources.access: Public attachment viewer. The UI shell remained blank, so the observed iframe URL and its documented public HTML fragments were read directly. No login or access-control bypass.
sources.inspection: Both two-page HTML bodies were read. None of the nine target glyphs is a named learning row. Non-target embedded stroke images were not independently evaluated. Viewer fragment hashes describe decoded HTML, not original HWP bytes.
sources.limitations: Temporary viewer result paths may change; reacquire through the stable school post/viewer URLs.
